summary: First-finish smoke testing for VOLT electronics store. All 5 backend endpoints work correctly (products list w/ filters/sort/search, categories with counts, single product + 404, order creation with all shipping methods + empty-items 400, order retrieval + 404). Full frontend checkout E2E flow works: PDP add-to-cart -> auto-opened cart drawer with correct count -> checkout page -> shipping form fill -> place order -> redirect to /comanda/{orderNumber} confirmation -> cart cleared on return home. Shop page lists 13 products, Boxe filter narrows to 3. Home loads. One minor issue: data-testid='order-number' element not found on confirmation page (order number is present in URL, so backend flow succeeded).
passed: GET /api/products?featured=true&sort=price_desc&limit=3 returns 3 featured sorted desc (Eclipse 549, Aura Max 449, Studio 329)
GET /api/categories returns 5 categories with counts (Casti=4, Boxe=3, Casti In-Ear=2, Wearables=2, Accesorii=2)
POST /api/orders standard <200 EUR -> shipping 15 (29 sub -> total 44)
POST /api/orders standard >=200 EUR -> shipping 0 (449 sub -> total 449)
GET /api/orders/{order_number} returns 200 for valid; 404 for invalid
Home page loads (title present, no fatal errors)
PDP /produs/volt-aura-max renders and pdp-add-to-cart works (auto-opens drawer, cart-count=1)
place-order-button creates order and redirects to /comanda/VLT-260725-071CF
Cart clears after successful order (no cart-count badge on home)

failed.issue: Element with data-testid='order-number' not found on /comanda/{orderNumber} confirmation page (query returned null)
failed.evidence: Confirmation URL loaded successfully (VLT-260725-071CF) and cart was cleared, but page.query_selector('[data-testid="order-number"]') returned None immediately after wait_for_url

action_items: Verify OrderConfirmation.jsx renders an element with data-testid='order-number' containing the order_number text (may be conditional on order fetch loading state or missing testid attribute)
